name: 02139 · Cambridge, MA
findings: ZIP 02139 (Cambridge) has 308 nonprofit organizations. 126 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 110 organizations.
Research and think tank organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02139 (Cambridge) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
